Bayesian model

Bayesian model specifications

# Bayesian models specifications ---------------------------------------------------------
# Define options for the NUTS sampler
nchains <- 4    # number of chains (at least 4 for NUTS sampling)
niter <- 10000   # number of iterations per chain
nwarm <- 5000   # number of iterations to warm up before sampling 
#4 x (10000-5000)= 20000 iterations

Models wet 0-10

pH Log model wet 0-10

#pHlog model
fitGLMM1_D <- brm(pHlog ~ PD.disturbance + Grass.type + PD.disturbance:Grass.type + (1|ID),
                  data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                  warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                  cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM1_D)
##  Family: gaussian 
##   Links: mu = identity; sigma = identity 
## Formula: pHlog ~ PD.disturbance + Grass.type + PD.disturbance:Grass.type + (1 | ID) 
##    Data: myData (Number of observations: 79) 
##   Draws: 4 chains, each with iter = 10000; warmup = 5000; thin = 1;
##          total post-warmup draws = 20000
## 
## Group-Level Effects: 
## ~ID (Number of levels: 12) 
##               Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## sd(Intercept)     0.64      0.25     0.28     1.24 1.00     5913    10177
## 
## Population-Level Effects: 
##                                       Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat
## Intercept                                 1.19      0.50     0.21     2.15 1.00
## PD.disturbanceWP                         -1.25      0.40    -2.03    -0.46 1.00
## Grass.typeArid                           -1.44      0.68    -2.80    -0.06 1.00
## Grass.typeCalcareous                     -1.33      0.68    -2.71     0.02 1.00
## Grass.typeMountain                       -1.44      0.70    -2.81    -0.07 1.00
## PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeArid           2.13      0.53     1.10     3.17 1.00
## PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeCalcareous     1.31      0.52     0.27     2.33 1.00
## PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeMountain       0.92      0.54    -0.14     1.98 1.00
##                                       Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## Intercept                                 9058    11464
## PD.disturbanceWP                         10297    12683
## Grass.typeArid                            9531    10636
## Grass.typeCalcareous                      9524    10513
## Grass.typeMountain                        9754    10522
## PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeArid          11646    13627
## PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeCalcareous    12220    14290
## PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeMountain      11762    13855
## 
## Family Specific Parameters: 
##       Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## sigma     0.79      0.07     0.66     0.95 1.00    14666    12638
## 
## Draws were sampled using sampling(NUTS). For each parameter, Bulk_ESS
## and Tail_ESS are effective sample size measures, and Rhat is the potential
## scale reduction factor on split chains (at convergence, Rhat = 1).
fitGLMM1_D$prior
##                    prior     class                                  coef group
##                   (flat)         b                                            
##                   (flat)         b                        Grass.typeArid      
##                   (flat)         b                  Grass.typeCalcareous      
##                   (flat)         b                    Grass.typeMountain      
##                   (flat)         b                      PD.disturbanceWP      
##                   (flat)         b       PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeArid      
##                   (flat)         b PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeCalcareous      
##                   (flat)         b   PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeMountain      
##  student_t(3, -0.1, 2.5) Intercept                                            
##     student_t(3, 0, 2.5)        sd                                            
##     student_t(3, 0, 2.5)        sd                                          ID
##     student_t(3, 0, 2.5)        sd                             Intercept    ID
##     student_t(3, 0, 2.5)     sigma                                            
##  resp dpar nlpar lb ub       source
##                             default
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                             default
##                   0         default
##                   0    (vectorized)
##                   0    (vectorized)
##                   0         default
pHlog1_D1<-fitGLMM1_D %>%
  emmeans( ~ PD.disturbance | Grass.type) %>%
  gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PD.disturbance, y = .value)) + labs( y = "pH scaled" )+
  stat_halfeye() +
  stat_summary(aes(group = NA), fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  facet_grid(~ Grass.type) +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"))+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  scale_color_manual(values ="black")
pHlog1_D1

emmeansph3<-emmeans(fitGLMM1_D,pairwise~PD.disturbance:Grass.type, adjust="tukey")

#conductivity log model 
fitGLMM2_D <- brm(conductivitylog ~ PD.disturbance + Grass.type + PD.disturbance:Grass.type + (1|ID),
                  data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                  warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                  cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM2_D)

  ggplot(aes(x = PD.disturbance, y = .value)) + labs( y = "Conductivity scaled" )+

  stat_summary(aes(group = NA), fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  facet_grid(~ Grass.type) +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +

  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  scale_color_manual(values ="black")

#K log model 

fitGLMM4_D <- brm(Klog ~ PD.disturbance + Grass.type + PD.disturbance:Grass.type + (1|ID),
                  data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                  warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                  cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM4_D)

#Mg log model 

fitGLMM5_D <- brm(Mglog ~ PD.disturbance + Grass.type + PD.disturbance:Grass.type + (1|ID),
                  data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                  warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                  cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM5_D)

##   Links: mu = identity; sigma = identity

##          total post-warmup draws = 20000

Mglog1_D2<-fitGLMM5_D %>%
  emmeans( ~ PD.disturbance | Grass.type) %>%
  gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PD.disturbance, y = .value)) + labs( y = "Mg scaled" )+
  stat_halfeye() +
  stat_summary(aes(group = NA), fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  facet_grid(~ Grass.type) +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"))+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  scale_color_manual(values ="black")
  Mglog1_D2

#P log model #has two divergences
fitGLMM7_D <- brm(P.TUDlog ~ PD.disturbance + Grass.type + PD.disturbance:Grass.type + (1|ID),
                  data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                  warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                  cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM7_D)

#Corg log model 
fitGLMM8_D <- brm(Corglog ~ PD.disturbance + Grass.type + PD.disturbance:Grass.type + (1|ID),
                  data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                  warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                  cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM8_D)

  emmeans( ~ PD.disturbance | Grass.type) %>%
  gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PD.disturbance, y = .value)) + labs( y = "C. Org scaled" )+
  stat_halfeye() +
  stat_summary(aes(group = NA), fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  facet_grid(~ Grass.type) +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"))+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  scale_color_manual(values ="black")

#Infiltration log model 
fitGLMM10_D1 <- brm(infiltrationlog ~ PD.disturbance + Grass.type + PD.disturbance:Grass.type + (1|ID),
                   data = Datainf, family = gaussian(),
                   warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                   control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                   cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
loofit10_D1<-add_criterion(fitGLMM10_D1, "loo")


fitGLMM10_D2 <- brm(infiltrationlog ~ PD.disturbance + Grass.type + PD.disturbance:Grass.type + (1|ID:Plot),
                   data = Datainf, family = gaussian(),
                   warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                   control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                   cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
loofit10_D2<-add_criterion(fitGLMM10_D2, "loo")

print(loo_compare(loofit10_D2,loofit10_D1,criterion = "loo"),simplify=F) # the top model with 0 is the best.

#Compaction log model 
fitGLMM11_D1 <- brm(compactionlog ~ PD.disturbance + Grass.type + PD.disturbance:Grass.type + (1|ID),
                   data = Datacomp, family = gaussian(),
                   warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                   control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                   cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
## Warning: There were 1 divergent transitions after warmup. See
## https://mc-stan.org/misc/warnings.html#divergent-transitions-after-warmup
## to find out why this is a problem and how to eliminate them.
## Warning: Examine the pairs() plot to diagnose sampling problems
loofit11_D1<-add_criterion(fitGLMM11_D1, "loo")


fitGLMM11_D2 <- brm(compactionlog ~ PD.disturbance + Grass.type + PD.disturbance:Grass.type + (1|ID:plot),
                   data = Datacomp, family = gaussian(),
                   warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                   control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                   cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
loofit11_D2<-add_criterion(fitGLMM11_D2, "loo")
## Warning: Found 1 observations with a pareto_k > 0.7 in model 'fitGLMM11_D2'. It
## is recommended to set 'moment_match = TRUE' in order to perform moment matching
## for problematic observations.
print(loo_compare(loofit11_D2,loofit11_D1,criterion = "loo"),simplify=F) # the top model with 0 is the best. 
##             elpd_diff se_diff elpd_loo se_elpd_loo p_loo  se_p_loo looic

  gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PD.disturbance, y = .value)) + labs( y = "Compaction scaled" )+
  stat_halfeye() +
  stat_summary(aes(group = NA), fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  facet_grid(~ Grass.type) +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"))+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  scale_color_manual(values ="black")

outputwet1 = list1[[1]]$emmeans
outputwet1$modelnr = rep(1, nrow(outputwet1))
## Error in rep(1, nrow(outputwet1)): invalid 'times' argument
for (i in c(2:length(list1))) {
     nextoutput = list1[[i]]$emmeans
     nextoutput$modelnr = rep(i, nrow(nextoutput))
     outputwet1 = dplyr::bind_rows(outputwet1, nextoutput)
}
